summary: Static code verification of Help & Support dropdown foreground fix in /app/frontend/app/support/index.tsx (Expo RN app; runtime headless browser interaction skipped per agent-to-agent note). Verified all 3 dropdowns (range, status, sort) render option menus inside a foreground React Native <Modal transparent statusBarTranslucent>, anchored via measureInWindow -> ddAnchor, with a tap-outside backdrop that closes the menu. All required testIDs are present and match the request.

modal_foreground_portal.evidence: line 72: <Modal visible={openDD === id} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={...} statusBarTranslucent> wraps the options list, so it is a foreground portal above the FlatList.

measured_anchor_positioning.evidence: lines 51-57: triggerRefs + openDropdown() calls node.measureInWindow((x,y,w,h) => setDdAnchor({x,y,w,h})). line 75: menu View uses position:'absolute', top: ddAnchor.y + ddAnchor.h + 4, left: ddAnchor.x, width: ddAnchor.w — positioned just under the trigger.

backdrop_closes_menu.evidence: line 73: <Pressable testID={`support-${id}-backdrop`} style={{ flex: 1 }} onPress={() => setOpenDD(null)}> spans the modal area and closes menu without selecting.

z_stack_over_cards.evidence: Menu is inside a native <Modal> (native window on Android) so it renders above the FlatList regardless of parent zIndex. Also elevation:24 and heavy boxShadow set for visual layering.

range_dropdown.evidence: line 109: <DD id="range" options={[['all','All time'],['7d','Last 7 days'],['30d','Last 30 days']]} .../>; testIDs built as support-${id} (line 68) and support-${id}-${v || 'all'} (line 76).

status_dropdown.evidence: line 112: options [['','All statuses'],['open','Open'],['in_progress','In progress'],['resolved','Resolved'],['closed','Closed']]; empty value '' maps to '-all' suffix via `v || 'all'`.

trigger_label_updates_and_closes.evidence: line 76: onPress={() => { onChange(v); setOpenDD(null); }} updates state and closes. line 69: label reads options.find(o=>o[0]===value)?.[1] — will re-render with new label.

runtime_verification: SKIPPED — per review_request note, this is a native Expo RN app; expo-web headless preview typically blank/non-interactive due to font & native module gating (react-native-firebase, notifee). Static verification performed instead as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The DD component is defined as an inline function inside SupportList (line 66), causing it to be re-created on every render. This is fine functionally but may cause TextInput focus loss issues in the search field on rapid re-renders. Consider useCallback or extracting the component.

Minor: ddAnchor is shared across all three dropdowns; if user rapidly opens different dropdowns before measureInWindow resolves, briefly the wrong anchor could be applied. Very edge-case, low priority.
Consider clearing ddAnchor on close (setDdAnchor(null)) to avoid a stale flash if menu re-opens before re-measure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified statically only. If runtime verification is required, use Expo Go on a real Android device: login partner +919000000003 OTP 123456, open Help & Support, tap each of support-range/support-status/support-sort triggers, confirm menu overlays ticket cards, tap backdrop to close. Web preview will not reliably render these RN Modals.
